# Gitcoin Grant
---

## Rules
- Gitcoin grants should only serve funding of public good. See the explanation of public goods in [**Wikipedia**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Public_good_(economics)).
-  All the funding of the grant should go toward the goal stated in the grant.
 - It is forbidden to impersonate a person or an entity in the grant description.
 -  People giving money to the grant should only do so because they want the public good to be funded. It is forbidden to offer a reward to people funding the grant.

## Disputed grant
The disputed grant is the **[Synergy of Serra](https://gitcoin.co/grants/1010/synergy-of-serra)**

## Reason for the dispute

_"Every person that donated to this grant has left a comment with the account address where they want the kickback"_
